📚 PATOIS WORD OF THE DAY: "BREDRIN"

🔤 Pronunciation: BRED-rin
📖 Definition: Close male friend, brother
🇬🇧 English: Friend/Brother

💬 How to use it:
"Wah gwaan bredrin!" = What's up friend!
"Mi bredrin dem nice" = My friends are cool

📜 History: Comes from "brethren" but evolved in Jamaican culture to mean close friendship and brotherhood beyond blood relations.

📚 PATOIS WORD OF THE DAY: "NYAM"

🔤 Pronunciation: NYAM
📖 Definition: To eat food
🇬🇧 English: Eat

💬 How to use it:
"Mi wah nyam some food" = I want to eat some food
"Nyam up yuh dinner" = Eat up your dinner

📜 History: This word has West African origins, particularly from Twi language where 'didinam' means to eat. It shows the strong African linguistic influence in Patois.

📚 PATOIS WORD OF THE DAY: "IRIE"

🔤 Pronunciation: EYE-ree
📖 Definition: Everything is good, alright, cool
🇬🇧 English: Alright/Good/Cool

💬 How to use it:
"Everything irie man" = Everything is good
"Yuh feel irie?" = Are you feeling good?

📜 History: Made famous worldwide by Bob Marley and reggae music. Represents the Rastafarian concept of positive vibrations and spiritual well-being.

📚 PATOIS WORD OF THE DAY: "PICKNEY"

🔤 Pronunciation: PICK-nee
📖 Definition: Child or young person
🇬🇧 English: Child/Kid

💬 How to use it:
"Di pickney dem a play" = The children are playing
"Mi have three pickney" = I have three children

📜 History: Derived from Portuguese 'pequenino' (little one) during colonial times, showing how Jamaican Patois absorbed words from multiple languages.

Yow! Mi ago teach yuh fi make Jerk Chicken:

🔥 JERK CHICKEN RECIPE:
• 2 lbs chicken
• 2 scotch bonnet peppers
• 4 cloves garlic
• 1 inch ginger
• 2 tbsp allspice
• 2 tbsp brown sugar
• 3 tbsp soy sauce
• Juice of 2 limes

Blend all seasonings, marinate chicken 4+ hours, then grill till crispy! 🇯🇲

Big up! Let mi show yuh Rice and Peas:

🍚 RICE AND PEAS:
• 2 cups rice
• 1 can coconut milk
• 1 can kidney beans
• 2 cups water
• 2 scallions
• 2 garlic cloves
• 1 scotch bonnet (whole)
• Salt and pepper

Boil coconut milk with beans and seasonings, add rice, cover and simmer 20 mins! Irie!

Respect! Here's how fi make Curry Goat:

🐐 CURRY GOAT:
• 3 lbs goat meat (or lamb)
• 3 tbsp curry powder
• 2 onions diced
• 4 garlic cloves
• 2 potatoes
• 2 cups water
• Salt and pepper

Season meat with curry overnight, brown in pot, add vegetables and water, simmer 2 hours till tender!

Cho! Let mi teach yuh Ackee and Saltfish:

🐟 ACKEE AND SALTFISH:
• 1 can ackee (or fresh)
• 1 lb saltfish
• 1 onion
• 2 tomatoes
• 2 scotch bonnet peppers
• Oil for cooking

Soak and boil saltfish, flake it, sauté with vegetables, gently fold in ackee. National dish right deh so!

Wicked! Here's Escovitch Fish recipe:

🐠 ESCOVITCH FISH:
• 2 lbs snapper
• 2 carrots julienned
• 1 onion sliced
• 2 scotch bonnet peppers
• 1/2 cup vinegar
• Oil for frying

Fry fish till golden, make pickle with vegetables and vinegar, pour over fish while hot. Sweet and sour vibes!
